photorealistic.label: photorealistic
photorealistic.llm_block: Photoreal still photography. Natural skin and material microdetail, physically plausible light, real lens falloff and mild grain.
photorealistic.suffix: Photoreal photograph, natural materials, physically plausible light.

cinematic_film_still.label: cinematic film still
cinematic_film_still.llm_block: A cinematic feature-film still. Anamorphic-adjacent widescreen, motivated practicals, rich contrast, color-graded drama.
cinematic_film_still.suffix: Cinematic feature-film still, widescreen, motivated practicals.

documentary_photography.label: documentary photography
documentary_photography.llm_block: Observational documentary photography. Available light, honest color, lived-in spaces, unposed framing.

analog_35mm_film.label: analog 35mm film
analog_35mm_film.llm_block: Shot on analog 35mm color negative. Fine film grain, slight halation, organic color, mild gate weave.
analog_35mm_film.suffix: Analog 35mm color-negative film grain and organic color.

analog_120_medium_format.label: analog 120 medium format
analog_120_medium_format.llm_block: Medium-format 120 film. Square-to-4x5 feel, creamy tones, shallow plane, fine grain, high resolving power.
analog_120_medium_format.suffix: Medium-format 120 film, creamy tones, fine grain.

polaroid_instant.label: Polaroid instant
polaroid_instant.llm_block: Instant Polaroid print. Soft contrast, creamy highlights, slight color shift, white frame implied by the look not burned-in text.
polaroid_instant.suffix: Instant Polaroid print look, soft contrast, creamy highlights.

golden_hour_photography.label: golden-hour photography
golden_hour_photography.llm_block: Golden-hour photography. Long warm sidelight, long shadows, amber rim, clear air.
golden_hour_photography.suffix: Golden-hour photograph, warm sidelight, long shadows.

overcast_natural_light.label: overcast natural light
overcast_natural_light.llm_block: Overcast natural light. Soft sky-fill, gentle falloff, cool neutrals, open shadows.
overcast_natural_light.suffix: Overcast natural light, soft sky-fill, open shadows.

studio_product_photography.label: studio product photography
studio_product_photography.llm_block: Studio product photography. Seamless cyclorama, soft key, controlled speculars, clean contact shadow.
studio_product_photography.suffix: Studio product photograph, seamless backdrop, soft key.

editorial_fashion_photography.label: editorial fashion photography
editorial_fashion_photography.llm_block: Editorial fashion photography. Stylized posing, precise styling, magazine lighting, polished color.
editorial_fashion_photography.suffix: Editorial fashion photograph, precise styling, magazine light.

street_photography.label: street photography
street_photography.llm_block: Street photography. Candid timing, mixed city light, layered depth, lived pavement and storefronts.
street_photography.suffix: Candid street photograph, mixed city light, layered depth.

architectural_photography.label: architectural photography
architectural_photography.llm_block: Architectural photography. Corrected verticals, material texture, dusk or daylight structure, empty of people unless asked.
architectural_photography.suffix: Architectural photograph, corrected verticals, material texture.

anime.label: anime
anime.llm_block: Japanese anime still. Clean cel color, sharp line, expressive eyes, cel-shaded planes, feature-film anime lighting.
anime.suffix: Japanese anime still, clean cel color, sharp line.

manga_screentone.label: manga screentone
manga_screentone.llm_block: Black-and-white manga panel. Ink line, screentone gradients, speed lines only if motion is asked, high-contrast blacks.

cartoon.label: cartoon
cartoon.llm_block: Bold cartoon illustration. Simple shapes, thick outline, flat cheerful color, readable silhouettes.
cartoon.suffix: Bold cartoon illustration, thick outline, flat color.

western_comic_book.label: western comic book
western_comic_book.llm_block: Western comic-book still. Inked contour, Ben-Day dots, heroic posing, saturated print color.
western_comic_book.suffix: Western comic-book inks, Ben-Day dots, saturated print color.

saturday_morning_cartoon.label: Saturday-morning cartoon
saturday_morning_cartoon.llm_block: Saturday-morning cartoon still. Limited palette, bouncing shapes, painted cel backgrounds, friendly proportions.
saturday_morning_cartoon.suffix: Saturday-morning cartoon cel, limited palette, painted background.

storybook_illustration.label: storybook illustration
storybook_illustration.llm_block: Children's storybook illustration. Soft watercolor-adjacent paint, gentle faces, narrative composition, warm paper.
storybook_illustration.suffix: Storybook illustration, soft paint, narrative composition.

watercolor_illustration.label: watercolor illustration
watercolor_illustration.llm_block: Transparent watercolor. Paper tooth, wet-into-wet blooms, granulation, luminous washes.
watercolor_illustration.suffix: Transparent watercolor on paper, wet-into-wet blooms.

gouache_illustration.label: gouache illustration
gouache_illustration.llm_block: Opaque gouache painting. Matte velvety pigment, graphic shapes, poster-like flats, hand-painted edges.
gouache_illustration.suffix: Opaque gouache painting, matte pigment, graphic shapes.

ink_and_wash.label: ink-and-wash
ink_and_wash.llm_block: Ink-and-wash drawing. Confident black ink, diluted grey washes, spare composition, paper white as light.
ink_and_wash.suffix: Ink-and-wash drawing, black ink and grey washes.

colored_pencil.label: colored pencil
colored_pencil.llm_block: Colored-pencil drawing. Layered strokes, paper grain, wax bloom, careful edges.
colored_pencil.suffix: Colored-pencil drawing, layered strokes, paper grain.

charcoal_sketch.label: charcoal sketch
charcoal_sketch.llm_block: Charcoal sketch. Soft vine blacks, kneaded-eraser lights, smudged midtones, raw paper.
charcoal_sketch.suffix: Charcoal sketch, vine blacks and kneaded-eraser lights.

line_art.label: line art
line_art.llm_block: Clean line art. Even black contour, minimal fill, design-drawing clarity, no color unless asked.
line_art.suffix: Clean black line art, minimal fill.

cel_shaded.label: cel-shaded
cel_shaded.llm_block: Cel-shaded illustration. Hard shadow bands, few value steps, graphic highlights, poster color.
cel_shaded.suffix: Cel-shaded illustration, hard shadow bands, graphic highlights.

risograph_print.label: risograph print
risograph_print.llm_block: Risograph print. Limited spot inks, slight misregistration, grainy stipple, matte paper.
risograph_print.suffix: Risograph print, limited spot inks, grainy stipple.

3d_feature_animation.label: 3D feature animation
3d_feature_animation.llm_block: 3D feature-animation still. Rounded forms, physically based materials, cinematic three-point light, subsurface skin or fabric.
3d_feature_animation.suffix: 3D feature-animation still, rounded forms, physically based materials.

pixar_like_3d.label: Pixar-like 3D
pixar_like_3d.llm_block: Stylized feature 3D. Appealing proportions, soft global illumination, tactile shaders, storybook clarity.
pixar_like_3d.suffix: Stylized feature 3D, appealing proportions, soft GI.

claymation.label: claymation
claymation.llm_block: Claymation still. Fingerprint clay, armature joints, practical miniature set, studio stop-motion light.
claymation.suffix: Claymation still, fingerprint clay, miniature set.

stop_motion.label: stop-motion
stop_motion.llm_block: Stop-motion puppet still. Fabric and foam latex, visible craft, practical scale set, tungsten key.
stop_motion.suffix: Stop-motion puppet still, practical miniature set.

unreal_engine_cinematic.label: Unreal Engine cinematic
unreal_engine_cinematic.llm_block: Real-time cinematic 3D. Lumen-like bounce, sharp materials, cinematic camera, high-contrast grade.
unreal_engine_cinematic.suffix: Real-time cinematic 3D, sharp materials, cinematic camera.

isometric_3d.label: isometric 3D
isometric_3d.llm_block: Isometric 3D view. 30-degree axonometric, even light, readable volumes, diorama scale.
isometric_3d.suffix: Isometric 3D diorama, even light, readable volumes.

low_poly.label: low-poly
low_poly.llm_block: Low-poly 3D. Faceted geometry, flat vertex color, simple shaders, toy-like volumes.
low_poly.suffix: Low-poly 3D, faceted geometry, flat vertex color.

voxel.label: voxel
voxel.llm_block: Voxel art. Cubic voxels, limited palette, chunky silhouettes, even lighting.
voxel.suffix: Voxel art, cubic voxels, limited palette.

oil_painting.label: oil painting
oil_painting.llm_block: Oil painting. Visible brushwork, fat-over-lean glaze, canvas weave, rich impasto highlights.
oil_painting.suffix: Oil painting, visible brushwork, canvas weave.

impressionist_painting.label: impressionist painting
impressionist_painting.llm_block: Impressionist oil. Broken color, outdoor light, loose strokes, vibrating complements.
impressionist_painting.suffix: Impressionist oil, broken color, outdoor light.

cubist.label: cubist
cubist.llm_block: Cubist painting. Faceted simultaneous viewpoints, geometric planes, muted earth and accent color.
cubist.suffix: Cubist painting, faceted planes, simultaneous viewpoints.

art_nouveau.label: art nouveau
art_nouveau.llm_block: Art Nouveau illustration. Whiplash curves, botanical ornament, flat decorative color, elegant contour.
art_nouveau.suffix: Art Nouveau illustration, whiplash curves, botanical ornament.

ukiyo_e_woodblock.label: ukiyo-e woodblock
ukiyo_e_woodblock.llm_block: Ukiyo-e woodblock print. Flat mineral pigments, keyblock line, patterned kimono or landscape, empty of modern logos.
ukiyo_e_woodblock.suffix: Ukiyo-e woodblock print, mineral pigments, keyblock line.

baroque_oil.label: baroque oil
baroque_oil.llm_block: Baroque oil. Dramatic chiaroscuro, deep umbers, theatrical spotlight, rich fabric.
baroque_oil.suffix: Baroque oil, dramatic chiaroscuro, theatrical spotlight.

digital_matte_painting.label: digital matte painting
digital_matte_painting.llm_block: Digital matte painting. Epic environment, photographic integration, atmospheric perspective, filmic grade.
digital_matte_painting.suffix: Digital matte painting, epic environment, atmospheric perspective.

concept_art.label: concept art
concept_art.llm_block: Production concept art. Readable design, paintover finish, clear materials, cinematic key light.
concept_art.suffix: Production concept art, readable design, cinematic key light.

cyberpunk.label: cyberpunk
cyberpunk.llm_block: Cyberpunk night. Wet asphalt, neon magenta and cyan, dense signage as abstract glow (empty of readable brands), rain haze.
cyberpunk.suffix: Cyberpunk night, wet asphalt, neon magenta and cyan.

solarpunk.label: solarpunk
solarpunk.llm_block: Solarpunk day. Greenery on architecture, warm sun, clean materials, hopeful civic space, unmarked facades.
solarpunk.suffix: Solarpunk day, greenery on architecture, warm sun.

film_noir.label: film noir
film_noir.llm_block: Film-noir still. High-contrast black and white, venetian-blind shafts, wet streets, hard key.
film_noir.suffix: Film-noir still, high-contrast black and white, hard key.

1970s_grain.label: 1970s grain
1970s_grain.llm_block: 1970s film still. Warm print, heavy grain, slightly desaturated primaries, zoom-lens period feel.
1970s_grain.suffix: 1970s film still, warm print, heavy grain.

vaporwave.label: vaporwave
vaporwave.llm_block: Vaporwave still. Sunset grid, pastel neon, chrome, VHS softness, empty of readable logos.
vaporwave.suffix: Vaporwave still, pastel neon, chrome, VHS softness.

pixel_art.label: pixel art
pixel_art.llm_block: Pixel art. Limited palette, visible pixels, cluster shading, 16-bit-era sprites and tiles.
pixel_art.suffix: Pixel art, limited palette, visible pixels, cluster shading.

papercraft.label: papercraft
papercraft.llm_block: Papercraft diorama. Cut paper layers, visible edges, construction-paper color, studio light.
papercraft.suffix: Papercraft diorama, cut paper layers, studio light.

blueprint_technical_drawing.label: blueprint technical drawing
blueprint_technical_drawing.llm_block: Blueprint technical drawing. White line on cyan ground, orthographic callouts as graphic marks (empty of readable type), precise geometry.
blueprint_technical_drawing.suffix: Blueprint technical drawing, white line on cyan ground.
